annotations.title: Add a logo, font or picture

description: The short way to add a file: a logo (the Primary), a font (role display or body) or a picture, from a public https url or its bytes. add_logo, add_font and add_pictures do the same with more say. For files on the agent's own machine, get_upload_link gives an address to send them to from your shell, so nothing big passes through your messages.

caption.description: For a picture: what it shows.

character.description: The business's own character it shows (a mascot, a host), by its name in add_characters; the picture joins that character.

data_base64.description: Or the file's bytes, base64 (as large as one MCP message carries, about 4 MB).

family.description: For a font: its family name.

filename.description: Its file name with its extension, when you have one.

kind.description: logo (the Primary), font (role display or body) or picture.

look.description: With character: which of its looks this is ("3D", "drawn flat"), by its name in add_characters.

place.description: The business's own place it shows, by its name in add_places; the picture joins that place.

url.description: A public https address of the file. Marsell fetches it itself (public addresses only, up to 8 MB).
